output.reason: Two weeks postpartum with detachment, constant crying and frightening thoughts of harming the baby — a possible postpartum psychiatric emergency requiring immediate in-person assessment and infant safety measures today.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. Thoughts of harming your baby two weeks after birth need urgent, in-person mental health assessment today. If possible, have someone you trust stay with you and care for the baby, and ask them to take you. If you feel you may act on these thoughts, or cannot get there safely, call 911.
